title: The ugly economics of consumer AI
slides: Can consumer AI survive its own economics?
Chatbots lose money on every free query
Even paid tiers barely cover inference costs
Check if your favorite AI tool still exists next year
thread_text:
1. Can Consumer AI Survive?

Every free query you type costs the company real money. That math is starting to break.

2. Chatbots Burn Cash

Inference costs scale with usage, not revenue. More users means more losses, not profits.

3. Paid Tiers Barely Cover

The $20 you pay often doesn't cover what you actually use. Companies eat the difference.

4. Power Users Subsidized

Casual subscribers fund the heavy users who max out limits daily. That's backwards.

5. Check Your AI Tool

Ask yourself: would you pay $50/month for it? If not, it might not exist next year.

instagram.caption:
Every free query you type costs the company real money — and that math is starting to break. 💸

Chatbots burn cash because costs scale with usage, not revenue. More users means more losses.

Your $20 subscription often doesn't even cover what you actually use. Casual subscribers end up funding power users who max out limits daily.

If your favorite AI tool disappeared tomorrow, what would you actually pay to keep it? 🤔 If the answer isn't $50/month, it might not exist next year. Check before you build your workflow around it. ⚠️
